description: Default capabilities for the BIG Hat Entertainment shell. Intentionally minimal — we only add fine-grained perms when a real-world feature needs them. See lib.rs alpha.3 incident: invalid perm names panic the Builder before setup() runs, killing the windows-subsystem process silently. alpha.48: added core:webview + core:window:allow-create/set-* so PresentationMode.openAudienceView() can spawn the second window via @tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow.
